context: 2026-11-12: PR #4220 merged (9e1f9208d7 2026-11-14T03:13:05Z). Root cause: uat-throughput-{duckdb,cedardb}-nightly.yaml ran official TPC-H with phases load,throughput; #4137's gate requires power and throughput, and the refusal went to the silenced console under --quiet (run_official also relabelled the exit as 'Benchmark execution failed: 1'). Fix: refusals print via fatal() to stderr under --quiet with a test; configs use load,power,throughput; gate unchanged. Second bug found and fixed: a TPC-H Q16 row count inside the loose non-reference-seed tolerance was recorded as an exact PASSED and failed export; now SKIPPED with a warning (result_capture and DataFrame validation, tests for both). Local: duckdb cell exit 0 at SF1, 132 queries passed, refresh included, validate_throughput_result ok for 3 streams. Remaining: close when the next nightly shows t3:throughput duckdb and cedardb green (CedarDB not run locally).
description: Nightly-v2 runs 43254687916 (2026-11-12) and 43453477982 (2026-11-13): t3:throughput duckdb and cedardb cells run `benchbox run-official tpch --scale 1.0 --phases load,throughput --streams 3 --seed 20260709 --quiet` and exit 1 after the banner with no error text (terminal_state no_json_nonzero, 'recorded no result_path'). Last green before PR #4137 (f4ffb30eaf, 2026-11-12), which made --official refuse partial phases and TPC-H runs without refresh functions. Likely two defects: the nightly throughput configs request a phase set the official gate now refuses, and the refusal is not printed under --quiet.
